title: The Pinata Gauntlet
description: The Pinata Gauntlet — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Excited Lad

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Destroy the Pinata in the Pinata Gauntlet off of Level 6 of Ratsputin's Gulag and return to the Excited Lad in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Excited Lad

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Destroy the Pinata in the Pinata Gauntlet off of Level 6 of Ratsputin's Gulag and return to the Excited Lad in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

Ahh, the Pinata Gauntlet! Did you ever used to watch Townston Gladiators? They had this awesome event called the Gauntlet. Well, this is nothing like that, but it was really cool and Haste was my favorite Gladiator! The Pinata Gauntlet is going to be tough, but I bet you could do it on Extreme!

Go to Level 6 of Ratsputin's Gulag and that is where you will find the entrance to the Pinata Invitational. Once you are there you will need to destroy the pinata. Return to me, the Excited Lad, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell when you are done.

Turn-in:

What was it like?! No way! Thaaaaat souuuunds sooooo cooool!

Objectives:

  • Destroy the Pinata

Level range: 75–100
